policy: Leaf waves precede callers. Same-wave packages own disjoint files and can run in parallel. A package in a later wave can start once its depends_on packages are accepted. Indirect callbacks and runtime/system boundaries need explicit contracts before composed tests. Do not implement fake success stubs for unfinished callees. Cyclic direct families are indivisible.
